qupath-extension-omero 0.2.4 API

Packages
Package
Description
qupath.ext.omero
The OMERO extension enable accessing images hosted on an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.core
This package contains the core functionalities of the extension.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis
This package contains classes that perform requests to the different web APIs.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities
This package contains entities used by several APIs.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities.shapes
This package contains subclasses of Shape, which represents regions that can be drawn to an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer
This package contains the IViewerApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer.imageentities
Image entities returned by the OMERO iViewer API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json
This package contains the JsonApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities
This package contains OMERO entities returned by the JSON API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.experimenters
This package contains OMERO entities related to permissions: OmeroExperimenter represents an OMERO experimenter. OmeroExperimenterGroup represents an OMERO group.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server
This package contains OMERO entities related the project/dataset/image and screen/plate/plate acquisition/well hierarchy.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server.image
This package contains an OmeroImage and internal classes.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.shapes
This package contains OMERO shapes.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.permissions
This package contains classes that indicates who can access a particular OMERO entity.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities
This package contains repository entities, which are elements belonging to the OMERO entity hierarchy.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities.serverentities
This package contains server entities, which are elements belonging to the project/dataset/image or screen/plate/plate acquisition/well hierarchy.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.serverinformation
This package contains serializable objects returned by requests that attempt to get information on a server.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient
This package contains the WebclientApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations
This package contains: Subclasses of Annotation, which represents metadata attached to OMERO entities. AnnotationCreator to create annotations from JSON. Classes used internally.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations.omeroannotations
This package contains records representing OMERO objects.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search
This package contains objects used for a search query: The SearchQuery class is used to send the query parameters.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webgateway
This package contains the WebGatewayApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.imageserver
This package contains the image server and the image builder of this extension.
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis
This package contains different methods to read the pixel values of an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.ice
This package uses the OMERO gateway to access pixel values of an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.mspixelbuffer
This package uses the OMERO pixel buffer microservice to access pixel values of an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.web
This package uses the OMERO JSON API to access pixel values of an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.preferences
 
qupath.ext.omero.gui
This package contains all UI elements of the extension.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser
This package contains menus and windows to browse an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedinformation
This package provides a window that displays detailed information on an OMERO entity.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedsearch
This package provides a window that allows to search for OMERO entities on a server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedsearch.cellfactories
This package contains cells that can be used with tables containing SearchResult elements.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.hierarchy
This package contains a TreeItem builder (HierarchyItem) and a cell factory (HierarchyCellFactory) that can work with a TreeView containing RepositoryEntity elements.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.connectionsmanager
This package contains UI elements to manage (connect to, disconnect from, remove) a connection to an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters
This package provides UI elements to send/import several entities of the current image to/from the corresponding OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters.forms
This package contains several forms used to prompt the user for parameters when sending/importing entities to/from an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters.importers
This package contains DataTransporter that import entities from an OMERO server to the currently opened image.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters.senders
This package contains DataTransporter that send entities to an OMERO server from the currently opened image.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.login
This package contains the LoginForm used to connect to an OMERO server and the WaitingWindow to displays a loading indicator.
